items.title: SDE bootstrap: inventory State Programming research in HelixNote

items.title: Attribute migration bootstrap changes to their work items (CI attribution repair)
items.description: ROS's dirty-path attribution check (enforced in CI via ROS_BASE_REF, not by local ./ros validate) found that completing WI-0001..WI-0019 after committing each change, rather than while it was still uncommitted, meant no completion event recorded the actual changed paths. This mechanical work item re-attributes the full migration diff against the PR base commit so CI's attribution check passes, without altering any doctrine/method/research content.

items.title: Build SDE distribution and project bootstrap system (@echelon-foundry/sde)
items.description: Deterministic packaging step and zero-dependency npx CLI (init/status/verify/update) distributing a curated SDE execution package (.sde/) to consuming repositories, independent of ROS.

items.title: Audit SDE distribution and project bootstrap implementation
items.description: Independent audit of the @echelon-foundry/sde distribution system: canonical-source authority, distribution mapping, determinism, manifest integrity, package contents, dependency count, init/status/verify/update behavior, path/symlink safety, ROS boundary, language neutrality, fresh-agent usability, and trust model. Fixes applied for confirmed defects found during the audit.

items.title: Add npm Trusted Publishing workflow and bump SDE package to 1.0.0
items.description: Adds .github/workflows/publish.yml (npm Trusted Publishing/OIDC, no stored NPM_TOKEN) that publishes @echelon-foundry/sde on a package.json version change pushed to the default branch. Bumps the package version from 0.1.0 to 1.0.0 as the designated first public release, per explicit user request.

items.title: Repair npm release merge artifact and attribution
items.description: Delete distribution/package.json.orig, an unresolved merge-backup artifact accidentally committed by merge 540fdc2; preserve and attribute the already-present distribution/package.json 1.0.1 release bump; restore ROS validation.

items.title: Fix npm trusted-publishing package metadata
items.description: Add the repository metadata required for npm OIDC provenance verification, normalize the CLI bin mapping rejected by npm publish, and validate @echelon-foundry/sde 1.0.1 for retry.

items.title: Reconcile structural locality and agent navigation research into SDE
Review tools/ros_cli.mjs responsibility boundaries
items.description: SDE-STRUCT-001 reports tools/ros_cli.mjs at 1,085 physical lines (strong-review band). Inspect its semantic responsibilities and split only if decomposition would improve locality without obscuring CLI flow; the warning alone is not proof of nonconformance.

items.title: Review research notes and finalize SDE context/structure integration
Convert @echelon-foundry/sde to an F#-owned, npm-distributed Echelon Foundry lifecycle tool
items.description: Replace the JavaScript lifecycle implementation with an F# core and thin CLI adapter, add the standardized init/status/verify/upgrade/doctor contract with --json, --dry-run, --check, --strict and --verbose, adopt the shared .echelon/ installation record behind an explicit configuration migration, and distribute self-contained per-platform executables through a minimal Node launcher. No consumer-visible behaviour is removed: update remains an alias for upgrade, bin/sde.mjs remains a working entry point, MANIFEST.json schema 1 is unchanged, and the built payload is byte-identical to the previous builder's output.

items.title: Attribute the F# distribution rewrite to its work item (CI attribution repair)
items.description: ROS's dirty-path attribution check, enforced in CI via ROS_BASE_REF rather than by local ./ros validate, found that completing WI-0029 after committing its changes meant the completion event recorded no paths. This mechanical work item re-attributes the full diff against the PR base so CI's attribution check passes. It changes no doctrine, method, research, or implementation content.

items.title: Make the publish trigger safe across a default-branch rename to main
items.description: The npm publish workflow's on.push.branches list is the only thing tying releases to a branch name. Renaming the default branch would stop publishing silently, with nothing failing to signal it. Lists both the new and current names so the rename is safe in either order, and rewrites docs/releasing.md to describe the release branch by role rather than hardcoding a name it cannot keep in sync. Historical research, evidence and audit records that name the branch are left untouched: they record provenance as it was and are not rewritten.
